items.title: 6.4.3 Tangents and Normals to Ellipse (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 195-197: 6.4.3 Tangents and Normals to Ellipse: intersection with y = mx + c, Tangency Condition, Do You Know box, Point of Tangency, Example 22 (tangent and normal at (x1, y1))

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum dekhenge ke ek seedhi line ellipse ke saath kya rishta rakh sakti hai: usay do points par kaat sakti hai, sirf ek point par chhoo sakti hai (tangent), ya bilkul door se guzar sakti hai. Phir hum woh shart (condition) nikalenge jis se line tangent banti hai, aur tangent ka ellipse ko chhoone wala point (point of contact) bhi. Aakhir mein ek point par tangent aur normal ki equations banayenge. Yeh sab Exercise 6.4 ke sawal 9, 10, 11 aur 12 mein seedha kaam aayega.

Humare paas ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ...(1) aur line \(y = mx + c\) ...(2) hain.
Humein in ke milne ke points (points of contact) aur tangent hone ki shart chahiye.
Jo point dono par ho, woh dono equations poori karta hai. Is liye ellipse ki equation mein \(y = mx + c\) rakhte hain:
\[\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{(mx+c)^2}{b^2} = 1\]
Denominators khatam karne ke liye \(a^2b^2\) se zarb dete hain:
\[b^2x^2 + a^2(mx+c)^2 = a^2b^2\]
Square khol kar:
\[b^2x^2 + a^2(m^2x^2 + 2mcx + c^2) = a^2b^2\]
\[b^2x^2 + a^2m^2x^2 + 2a^2mcx\]
\[\quad + a^2c^2 - a^2b^2 = 0\]
\(x^2\) wale terms ikatthe kar ke:
\[(b^2 + a^2m^2)x^2 + 2a^2mcx\]
\[\quad + a^2(c^2 - b^2) = 0 \quad \text{...(3)}\]
Yeh \(x\) mein quadratic equation hai. Is ke roots un do points ke x-coordinates hain jahan line aur ellipse milte hain. Har \(x\) ko \(y = mx + c\) mein rakhne se us ka \(y\) mil jata hai. Aam taur par line aur ellipse do points par milte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Idea seedha sa hai: jo point line par bhi ho aur ellipse par bhi, woh dono equations ko poora karega. \(y\) ki jagah \(mx + c\) rakhne se sirf \(x\) wali ek equation bachti hai, jo quadratic hai.
Quadratic ke do, ek (dohraya hua) ya koi real root nahi hota. Isi tarah line ellipse ko do points par kaatti hai (secant), ek point par chhooti hai (tangent), ya us se door rehti hai. Kaun si surat hai, yeh discriminant batata hai. Yaad kijiye: \(Ax^2 + Bx + C = 0\) ka discriminant \(B^2 - 4AC\) hai.
Tangency Condition

Tangent ka matlab hai sirf ek common point, yani quadratic (3) ke dono roots barabar. Is ke liye discriminant \(D = 0\) hona chahiye. Yahan \(A = b^2 + a^2m^2\), \(B = 2a^2mc\), \(C = a^2(c^2 - b^2)\):
\[(2a^2mc)^2 - 4(b^2 + a^2m^2) \cdot a^2(c^2 - b^2)\]
\[= 0\]
\[4a^4m^2c^2 - 4a^2(b^2 + a^2m^2)(c^2 - b^2)\]
\[= 0\]
\(4a^2\) common nikaal kar:
\[4a^2\left[a^2m^2c^2 - (b^2 + a^2m^2)(c^2 - b^2)\right]\]
\[= 0\]
\(a \ne 0\), is liye bracket hi zero hoga:
\[a^2m^2c^2 - (b^2 + a^2m^2)(c^2 - b^2) = 0\]
Doosra term khol kar (dhyan se, minus poore bracket par hai):
\[a^2m^2c^2 - b^2c^2 + b^4\]
\[\quad - a^2m^2c^2 + a^2m^2b^2 = 0\]
\(a^2m^2c^2\) cancel ho gaya:
\[a^2m^2b^2 - b^2c^2 + b^4 = 0\]
\(b^2\) se divide (kyunke \(b \ne 0\)):
\[a^2m^2 - c^2 + b^2 = 0\]
To tangent hone ki shart yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: c squared equals a squared m squared plus b squared, so c equals plus or minus the square root of a squared m squared plus b squared, equation 4

blocks.text: \(c\) ki yeh qeemat \(y = mx + c\) mein rakhne se \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}\) milta hai. Yani har slope \(m\) ke liye ellipse ke do tangents hain, ek upar aur ek neeche, jo aapas mein parallel hain.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Agar paani ka glass tircha (tilt) kiya jaye to paani ki satah (surface) ellipse ki shakal ban jati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Barabar roots ka matlab tangent kyun? Barabar roots se sirf ek common point milta hai, yani line ellipse ko bas chhoo kar guzar jati hai, kaat'ti nahi.
Isi discriminant se baaqi surtein bhi milti hain: \(c^2 < a^2m^2 + b^2\) ho to line secant hai (do points); \(c^2 > a^2m^2 + b^2\) ho to line ellipse se door hai (koi point nahi). Exercise 6.4 ka sawal 10 isi par hai.
Hamari taraf se misaal: \(\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{9} = 1\) aur slope \(m = 1\) ke liye \(c^2 = 16(1) + 9 = 25\), to tangents \(y = x + 5\) aur \(y = x - 5\) hain.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(c\) line ka y-intercept hai, ellipse ka focal distance nahi. Ek hi harf (letter) do mukhtalif cheezon ke liye istemal ho raha hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Teeno suraton ko ek hi ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{9} + \frac{y^2}{4} = 1\) par dekhte hain, slope \(m = 2\) ke saath. Yahan \(a^2m^2 + b^2 = 9(4) + 4 = 40\).
Line \(y = 2x - 3\): \(c^2 = 9 < 40\), to yeh secant hai, ellipse ko do points par kaat'ti hai.
Line \(y = 2x + \sqrt{40}\): \(c^2 = 40\), to yeh tangent hai, sirf ek point par chhooti hai.
Line \(y = 2x + 7\): \(c^2 = 49 > 40\), to yeh ellipse se door guzarti hai, koi common point nahi.
Dekhiye, teeno lines parallel hain (slope 2), farq sirf intercept \(c\) ka hai. Intercept chhota ho to line ellipse ke beech se guzarti hai, bilkul sahi ho to kinare ko chhooti hai, aur bara ho to bahar nikal jati hai. Jaise ek rassi ko ek gend (ball) ke upar se aahista aahista neeche laayein: pehle door, phir chhooti hai, phir andar dhans jati hai.
Khud sochiye: \(y = 2x - 3\) wali line ko Exercise 6.4 ke sawal 10 mein dobara dekhenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Derivation ko dobara chaar qadmon mein dekhiye, taa ke yaad rahe: (1) line ko ellipse mein rakho, (2) \(x\) ki quadratic banao, (3) tangent ke liye discriminant zero karo, (4) simplify kar ke \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\) pao.
Yeh chaar qadam har conic ke liye ek jaise hain. Parabola \(y^2 = 4ax\) mein isi tareeqe se \(c = \frac{a}{m}\) mila tha, aur hyperbola (6.5) mein \(c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2\) milega. Sirf aakhri formula badalta hai, tareeqa wohi rehta hai.
Exam mein agar formula bhool jayein to ghabraiye nahi: yeh chaar qadam laga kar do minute mein shart khud nikal sakte hain. Is liye formula ke saath us ka raasta bhi yaad rakhiye.
Ek aur faida: agar sawal mein line \(y = mx + c\) ki shakal mein na ho, maslan \(2x - y = 3\), to pehle usay \(y = 2x - 3\) ki shakal mein likhiye, phir \(m\) aur \(c\) parhiye. Is chhote qadam ko chhorna aksar ghalti ki wajah banta hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Sawal: kya kisi bhi slope \(m\) ke liye ellipse ka tangent hamesha milta hai? Shart \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\) ka right side hamesha positive hai, is liye \(c\) hamesha real milta hai. Yani har slope ke do tangents mojood hain. (Hyperbola mein aisa nahi hoga; wahan kuch slopes ke liye koi tangent nahi hota.)
Sawal: horizontal tangents (\(m = 0\)) kaun se hain? \(c^2 = b^2\), to \(y = \pm b\), yani co-vertices par upar aur neeche ki lines. Tasweer mein dekhiye, bilkul yahi nazar aata hai.
Point of Tangency

Ab tangent \(y = mx + \sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}\) lein; isay (5) kehte hain. Is ke liye quadratic (3) ke roots barabar hain, aur barabar root \(x = -\frac{B}{2A}\) hota hai:
\[x = \frac{-2a^2mc}{2(b^2 + a^2m^2)} = \frac{-a^2mc}{c^2}\]
Kyunke (4) se \(b^2 + a^2m^2 = c^2\). Is liye:
\[x = \frac{-a^2m}{c} = \frac{-a^2m}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}\]
Yeh \(x\) line (5) mein rakhein:
\[y = \frac{-a^2m^2}{c} + c = \frac{c^2 - a^2m^2}{c} = \frac{b^2}{c}\]
Is tarah (5) aur (1) ka point of contact \(\left(\frac{-a^2m}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}, \frac{b^2}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}\right)\) hai.
Isi tarah \(y = mx - \sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}\) (yahan \(c = -\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}\)) aur (1) ka point of contact \(\left(\frac{a^2m}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}, \frac{-b^2}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}\right)\) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ke is hisse mein kai printing ki ghaltiyan hain, jo upar sahi kar di gayi hain:
Tangent \(y = mx + \sqrt{a^2m^2 - 5}\) chhapa hai; sahi \(y = mx + \sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}\) hai.
Denominator \(2(b^2 + a^2 + m^2)\) chhapa hai; sahi \(2(b^2 + a^2m^2)\) hai.
'We have equation of' aur 'Into 0 (5) we have' bematlab jumle hain; matlab hai 'to \(x\) yeh hai' aur '(5) mein rakhne se'.
Doosre tangent ka point \(\left(\frac{a^2m}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}, \frac{b^2}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}\right)\) chhapa hai; y-coordinate negative hona chahiye: \(\frac{-b^2}{\sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}}\). Kitab wala point us line par hai hi nahi.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: tangent \(y = mx + c\) (jahan \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\)) ka point of contact \(\left(-\frac{a^2m}{c}, \frac{b^2}{c}\right)\) hai, \(c\) ka sign chahe kuch bhi ho.
Misaal: \(\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{9} = 1\) par \(m = 1\), \(c = 5\): point \(\left(-\frac{16}{5}, \frac{9}{5}\right)\). Tasdeeq: \(\frac{256}{400} + \frac{81}{225} = 0.64 + 0.36 = 1\). Aur line par bhi: \(-\frac{16}{5} + 5 = \frac{9}{5}\). Dono theek.

Ab Example 22 mein hum ellipse ke kisi bhi point par tangent aur normal ki general equations banayenge. Yahan pehle wala tareeqa (line rakh kar discriminant) bhi chal sakta tha, lekin derivative wala tareeqa ziyada seedha hai, kyunke derivative hi kisi point par curve ka slope deta hai. Normal woh line hai jo usi point se tangent par perpendicular (90 degree par) guzarti hai.

blocks.title: Example 22
blocks.problem: Find equation of the tangent and normal to the ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) at the point \((x_1, y_1)\).
steps:
Diya gaya: ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) aur us par point \((x_1, y_1)\).
Maloom karna: is point par tangent aur normal ki equations.
Tareeqa: implicit differentiation se point par slope, phir point-slope form \(y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)\). Normal tangent par perpendicular hai, is liye us ka slope tangent ke slope ka negative reciprocal hoga.

Implicit differentiation
\(x\) ke lehaz se differentiate karein:
\[\frac{2x}{a^2} + \frac{2y}{b^2}\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{b^2}{a^2}\frac{x}{y}\]
Kyun: \(y\) bhi \(x\) par munhasir hai, is liye \(y^2\) ka derivative chain rule se \(2y\frac{dy}{dx}\) hai. Phir \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela kiya.

Point par slope
\[\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)_{(x_1, y_1)} = -\frac{b^2x_1}{a^2y_1}\]
Kyun: Slope ki general formula mein point ke coordinates rakh diye.

Tangent ki equation
\[y - y_1 = -\frac{b^2x_1}{a^2y_1}(x - x_1)\]
Kyun: Point-slope form: point aur slope dono maloom hain.

\(\frac{y_1}{b^2}\) se zarb dein
\[\frac{yy_1}{b^2} - \frac{y_1^2}{b^2} = -\frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{x_1^2}{a^2}\]
Kyun: Is se fractions saaf ho jate hain aur \(x\), \(y\) ke terms ek jaisi shakal mein aa jate hain.

Tarteeb dein
\[\frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = \frac{x_1^2}{a^2} + \frac{y_1^2}{b^2}\]
Kyun: \(x\) aur \(y\) wale terms left par, baaqi right par.

\((x_1, y_1)\) ellipse par hai
\[\frac{x_1^2}{a^2} + \frac{y_1^2}{b^2} = 1\]
\[\Rightarrow \frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\]
Kyun: Point ellipse par hai, is liye us ke coordinates ellipse ki equation poori karte hain; right side 1 ban gayi.

Normal ki equation
Normal ka slope \(\frac{a^2y_1}{b^2x_1}\) hai.
\[y - y_1 = \frac{a^2y_1}{b^2x_1}(x - x_1)\]
Kyun: Perpendicular lines ke slopes ka hasil-e-zarb \(-1\) hota hai, is liye tangent ke slope ko ulat kar sign badla.

\(b^2x_1\) se zarb aur tarteeb
\[b^2x_1y - b^2x_1y_1 = a^2y_1x - a^2x_1y_1\]
Tarteeb dene se:
\[a^2y_1x - b^2x_1y = x_1y_1(a^2 - b^2)\]
Kyun: \(b^2x_1\) se zarb dene se fraction khatam hua; phir \(x\), \(y\) wale terms ek taraf aur \(x_1y_1\) wale doosri taraf.

Dono sides ko \(x_1y_1\) se divide karein (\(x_1 \ne 0,\ y_1 \ne 0\))
\[\frac{a^2x}{x_1} - \frac{b^2y}{y_1} = a^2 - b^2\]
Kyun: Is se normal ki saaf shakal milti hai. \(x_1\) ya \(y_1\) zero ho (yani point vertex ya co-vertex ho) to divide nahi kar sakte; wahan normal seedha axis hi hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(a = 5\), \(b = 3\) aur point \((3, \frac{12}{5})\) lein (yeh ellipse par hai: \(\frac{9}{25} + \frac{16}{25} = 1\)). Tangent \(\frac{3x}{25} + \frac{4y}{15} = 1\) is point se guzarta hai: \(\frac{9}{25} + \frac{16}{25} = 1\), aur is ka slope \(-\frac{9}{20}\) wohi hai jo \(-\frac{b^2x_1}{a^2y_1} = -\frac{27}{60}\) deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Dividing both sides by by \(x_1y_1\)' chhapa hai, yani lafz 'by' do dafa aa gaya. Sahi: 'Dividing both sides by \(x_1y_1\)'.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Tangent \(\frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\) ko ellipse ki equation \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ke saath rakh kar dekhiye. Kya farq hai? Bas \(x^2\) ki jagah \(xx_1\) aur \(y^2\) ki jagah \(yy_1\). Yeh 'aadha aadha badlo' wala qaida circle aur parabola mein bhi chalta hai, is liye ise yaad rakhna aasaan hai.
Vertex \((a, 0)\) par tangent kya hoga? \(x_1 = a\), \(y_1 = 0\) rakhein: \(\frac{xa}{a^2} = 1\), yani \(x = a\), ek vertical line. Tasweer mein bhi yahi nazar aata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
Line \(y = mx + c\) ko ellipse mein rakhne se quadratic (3) milti hai.
Tangent: \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\); secant: \(c^2 < a^2m^2 + b^2\); koi common point nahi: \(c^2 > a^2m^2 + b^2\).
Slope \(m\) wale tangents: \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 + b^2}\); point of contact \(\left(-\frac{a^2m}{c}, \frac{b^2}{c}\right)\).
\((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent: \(\frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\); normal: \(\frac{a^2x}{x_1} - \frac{b^2y}{y_1} = a^2 - b^2\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
\(c\) ke do matlab gadmad kar dena: \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\) mein \(c\) line ka y-intercept hai, focal distance \(\sqrt{a^2 - b^2}\) nahi.
\((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent \(\frac{x^2x_1}{a^2} + \ldots\) likh dena: sirf \(x^2\) ko \(xx_1\) aur \(y^2\) ko \(yy_1\) se badalna hai.
Normal ke liye tangent ka slope hi use kar lena: normal ka slope tangent ke slope ka negative reciprocal hai.
Discriminant kholte waqt \(-(b^2 + a^2m^2)(c^2 - b^2)\) ka minus sirf pehle term par lagana; minus poore hasil-e-zarb par hai.
